featured.title: Get to know VS Code
featured.description: Understand how projects, language tools, and optional AI fit together, then choose your first hands-on task.

highlights.title: Learn the editor
highlights.description: Create, preview, and debug a small app while learning the editor. No AI required.

highlights.title: Build your first app with AI
highlights.description: Build a small web app with an AI agent, test it in the browser, and review the generated changes.

highlights.title: Your agents, one inbox
highlights.description: Stay on top of agent work with inbox mode: focus on sessions that need your attention and snooze others for later. Compare model results side by side, give chats their own windows, and install extensions without leaving the Agents window.
